> Plan · Summit Az · 2026-05-29

# Summary
Missing-city draft for `water-leak-detection-scottsdale`, templated on Water Leak Detection Chandler (ID 3684). The Scottsdale page existed but was private (ID 3995) per the 2026-05-20 snapshot.

# Key facts
- Primary keyword "water leak detection in Scottsdale"; supporting terms include leak detection services, hidden water leak detection, near-me variants.
- GEO entities: Scottsdale Water (tiered billing and leak adjustment refund process); Old Town, McCormick Ranch, Gainey Ranch, DC Ranch, Silverleaf, Troon, Desert Mountain; 1960s to 1980s copper supply lines prone to slab leaks.
- Adds a seventh leak type, pool and spa plumbing leaks, for Scottsdale only.
- 7-question FAQ (including whether Scottsdale Water gives a credit) and Service + Plumber schema.
- The live page (ID 5771) shows a 2026-06-17 post date in `_sheet\pages_live.csv`; staged files are in [Summit AZ - WP Staging Pages](lib:brain-summit-az-wp-staging-pages).
